convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iHigh/iLow/iHighest/iLowest, iATR). Simple breakout entry/exit with stop orders. Risk-percent position sizing. Only external include is Trade.mqh for order execution which has standard Python equivalents. No custom indicators or complex multi-timeframe hedging logic.

Prop firm: all positions and orders closed if equity < starting_balance - DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT

custom_logic_notes: Breakout channel strategy: buy stop above HighestHigh of lookback period, sell stop below LowestLow of lookback period. All pending orders deleted and recreated each new bar. Orders split across multiple orders if lot_size exceeds SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX. Prop firm challenge helper disables trading when daily loss limit breached or profit target reached. SL for long = exit_long (LowestLow of EXIT_PERIOD), SL for short = exit_short (HighestHigh of EXIT_PERIOD). Trailing stop only moves SL if new trail level is at least 0.1*ATR better than current SL and respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL distance from current price. Position close (not just trail) triggered when price crosses trail level unfavorably.
python_conversion_notes: Breakout channel is straightforward: highest high / lowest low over N bars. ATR for trailing threshold is standard. Position sizing uses OrderCalcProfit equivalent which in Python requires knowing tick_value and tick_size for the symbol. Pending order management (delete-all then recreate each bar) is a simple pattern. Prop firm daily loss check requires parsing trade history by day - implement with pandas grouping on deal timestamps. Multiple order splitting for volume > max_volume is an edge case to handle. SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL check before placing stop orders must be preserved. No custom indicator handles to manage.
